# Currency reference

The wallet component, the currency asset, and the fixed amounts and drop ranges other modules use for prices, costs and loot. For how to use it, see [Currency](../modules/currency.md).

## VtUnitWallet

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Currency → VtUnitWallet**.

Opt-in per-unit wallet: the balance of every `VtCurrencyDefinition` the unit holds. Add it to units that earn or spend money, such as players and merchants. Changes are authority-gated, and `ApplyWalletFromNet` mirrors the authority's balances on other copies.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyDictionary<VtCurrencyDefinition, int> Balances { get; }` | Read-only view of every (currency, balance) pair currently tracked. Iteration order is unspecified; sort by `VtCurrencyDefinition.sortWeight` in your UI layer. |
| `event Action<VtCurrencyDefinition, int> OnChanged` | Fires after any balance change. Args: (currency, newBalance). Subscribe for UI updates / quest tracking ("collect 100 gold"). |
| `int Get(VtCurrencyDefinition currency)` | Current balance for the given currency. Returns 0 for currencies the wallet has never seen — distinguish "owned 0" from "never owned" via `Balances`.`ContainsKey` if you need the difference. |
| `bool CanAfford(VtCurrencyDefinition currency, int amount)` | True when the wallet can afford `amount` of `currency`. Use before invoking the spend flow so vendors / repair / training can show "not enough gold" UI without attempting the deduction. |
| `void Add(VtCurrencyDefinition currency, int amount)` | Credit `amount` of `currency`. Authority-gated. Negative amounts no-op (use `TryRemove` or `Set` for deductions). Fires `OnChanged`. |
| `bool TryRemove(VtCurrencyDefinition currency, int amount)` | Try to spend `amount` of `currency`. Returns true on success, false (and no mutation) when the wallet can't afford it. Authority-gated. |
| `void Set(VtCurrencyDefinition currency, int value)` | Force-set the balance to an absolute value. Authority-gated. Used by save-game restore, admin commands, and net replication's authoritative-rebroadcast path. Negative values clamp to 0. |
| `void Clear()` | Wipe every balance — typically for new-character creation / admin reset. Authority-gated. Fires `OnChanged` per cleared currency so UI can update incrementally. |
| `void ApplyWalletFromNet(IReadOnlyDictionary<VtCurrencyDefinition, int> snapshot)` | Net-replication entry point. Replaces the wallet with the authoritative snapshot. Bypasses the authority gate. Fires `OnChanged` for every currency whose balance differs from before the mirror. |

## VtCurrencyDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Currency → Currency**.

Authored currency type — the SO that names a currency, gives it an inspector colour, and defines its sort priority. Multi-currency games (gold + honor + marks + premium) author one per type and the wallet tracks each independently.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty | Stable id used in logs and as a stable serialization key. Convention: 'currency.<name>' (e.g. 'currency.gold', 'currency.honor'). Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | Designer-facing name. Shown in inspector dropdowns and wallet UI (consumer-side; library exposes the value, consumer renders it). |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty | Designer-facing description. Doesn't affect runtime behavior. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None | Icon for inspector + wallet UI. Optional. |
| Icon Id (`iconId`) | `string` | Empty | Name of an icon from the package's icon set (VtIcons), used when Icon is empty. Optional. |
| Color (`color`) | `Color` | `#FFFFFFFF` | Inspector tint colour (UI text, drop labels). Default white. |
| Sort Weight (`sortWeight`) | `int` | 0 | Sort priority for wallet UI iteration order. Lower = appears first (gold before silver before premium). Authoring convention: 0/100/200/300 tiers leave room to insert intermediate currencies later without renumbering. |

## VtCurrencyAmount

Serializable struct.

Fixed (currency, amount) pair — for cost / price / fee values that don't have an RNG range (build costs, vendor prices, repair fees). Distinct from `VtCurrencyDropEntry` which has min/max for loot rolls.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Currency (`currency`) | [VtCurrencyDefinition](#vtcurrencydefinition) | None |  | Currency type. Required — pair silently no-ops if null. |
| Amount (`amount`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Amount. 0 = free / no-op for cost contexts. |

## VtCurrencyDropEntry

Serializable struct.

One currency-drop row on a `VtLootTableDefinition`. Always-emit (no weighted competition); the amount rolls between `minAmount` and `maxAmount`, both included.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Currency (`currency`) | [VtCurrencyDefinition](#vtcurrencydefinition) | None |  | Currency to credit on death. Required — entry is silently skipped if null. |
| Min Amount (`minAmount`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum amount credited. Inclusive. The actual amount rolls in [min, max] per drop. |
| Max Amount (`maxAmount`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Maximum amount credited. Inclusive. Equal to minAmount = always credits exactly that amount. |
